top_choice_rationale: P001 names Drucker, Holst and Mojsov for the physiology of GLP-1 and the identification of its active form. That is the discovery that explains the incretin effect and underlies the later long-acting agonists and outcome trials, and it is mature after decades of independent confirmation. The citation can be worded narrowly so that it claims no first identification against contributors outside the credited list, which keeps the contested priority question open. P002 is a defensible second choice because Knudsen's acylation work is documented in approved drugs, but it moves the citation toward a product line. Both are preferable to no award, since the achievement is exceptional and the committee agrees on two of the three names.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile for the B007 candidates; profile notes past nuclear-receptor co-authorship with Ronald Evans (not credited on this slate) and co-authored works with chair Per Svenningsson and one with Abdel El Manira, none concerning this achievement
